parameters.content:
## 🌐 Workflow 8 — CareerPulse: OAuth Job Hunter Web App, Split-Screen Studio & Career Academy

### 1. Public Career & Interview Academy (`GET /webhook/job-dashboard`)
- **Career & Analytics Blog**, **18+ Interview-Ready Q&A Vault**, **6-Pillar Interview Preparation Blueprint & Interactive Checklist**, and **30-60-90 Day Job Success Playbook**.

### 2. OAuth Protected Owner Command Center (`POST /webhook/job-dashboard-api`)
- **Desktop Split-Screen Studio**: Job Details, Control Buttons & Section Rewriter on the Left + Embedded Google Drive PDF & Live A4 Document Preview on the Right (`📄 Custom Resume` ↔ `✉️ Cover Letter` ↔ `🎓 Master Resume`).
- **Graphical Funnel & Analytics**, **Interactive Master Table**, **`Generate new jobs` (Non-Collision Batch 25)**, **LinkedIn Queue + `li_at` Cookie**, **Friends & HR Network**, and **Learned Rules & Portals Vault**.

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM resume_generations) AS resume_gens_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM cover_letter_generations) AS cl_gens_total,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ja)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT s_no, user_id, resume_id, company_name, industry, job_id, position_title,
           CASE WHEN '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' = 'db_monitor' THEN '' ELSE LEFT(jd_text, 1400) END AS jd_text,
           location, portal_name, jd_url, status, resume_status,
           cl_status, combined_doc_status, applied_on, follow_up_date, created_on, last_updated,
           reference_name, hr_name, hr_email, hr_phone, reviewer_notes, cl_notes, general_notes,
           CASE WHEN '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' = 'db_monitor' THEN '' ELSE about_company END AS about_company,
           resume_drive_url, cl_drive_url, updated_at
    FROM job_applications
    ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(s_no, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) ASC NULLS LAST
  ) ja) AS job_apps,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(lc)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT cache_key, task_type, response_json, hit_count
    FROM llm_semantic_cache
    WHERE expires_at > NOW() AND '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' <> 'db_monitor'
    ORDER BY last_hit_at DESC LIMIT 250
  ) lc) AS llm_cache,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(up)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM careerpulse_ui_patches ORDER BY created_at DESC) up) AS ui_patches,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(pt)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM careerpulse_product_todos ORDER BY sort_order ASC, todo_id ASC) pt) AS product_todos,
  (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(session_cookies, ''), NULLIF(encrypted_password, '')) FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name IN ('LinkedIn_Session_Cookie', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'LinkedIn Jobs') AND LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(session_cookies, ''), NULLIF(encrypted_password, ''), '')) > 15 LIMIT 1) AS li_at_cookie,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rg)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM resume_generations
    WHERE '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' <> 'db_monitor'
    ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(s_no, resume_id, '0'), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) ASC NULLS LAST
  ) rg) AS resume_gens,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rgm)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT resume_id, s_no, company_name, position_title, resume_status, revision_count, last_reviewer_note,
           LEFT(heading_html, 240) AS heading_html, LEFT(summary_html, 320) AS summary_html, updated_at
    FROM resume_generations
    WHERE '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' = 'db_monitor'
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 40
  ) rgm) AS resume_gens_monitor,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(cg)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM cover_letter_generations
    WHERE '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' <> 'db_monitor'
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
  ) cg) AS cl_gens,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(cgm)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT resume_id, s_no, company_name, position_title, cl_status, revision_count, last_review_note,
           LEFT(heading_html, 240) AS heading_html, LEFT(salutation_html, 240) AS salutation_html, updated_at
    FROM cover_letter_generations
    WHERE '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' = 'db_monitor'
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 40
  ) cgm) AS cl_gens_monitor,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(lr)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT id, section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, created_at
    FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id DESC
  ) lr) AS all_learned_rules,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ll)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (activity_id) * FROM linkedin_activity_log ORDER BY activity_id, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
    ) d_ll
    ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(activity_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) DESC NULLS LAST
  ) ll) AS li_logs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(fc)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (contact_id) * FROM linkedin_network_contacts ORDER BY contact_id, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
    ) d_fc
    ORDER BY CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(contact_id, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INT) DESC NULLS LAST
  ) fc) AS fh_contacts,
  (SELECT row_to_json(ls) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM linkedin_daily_stats WHERE stat_date = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1
  ) ls) AS li_stats,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT site_name, portal_url, profile_review_url, login_method, auth_email, communication_email,
           username, auth_status, profile_approval_status, custom_preferences_note, updated_at
    FROM portal_credentials_vault
    WHERE site_name NOT IN ('Gmail_008_IMAP_SMTP', 'SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub', 'CareerPulse_Web_Session', 'LinkedIn_Session_Cookie')
    ORDER BY site_name ASC
  ) v) AS vault_rows,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT site_name, portal_url, login_method, auth_email, auth_status,
           CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(session_cookies, '')) > 15 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_cookie,
           updated_at
    FROM portal_credentials_vault
    WHERE site_name IN ('SSO_Master_LinkedIn', 'SSO_Master_GitHub')
  ) s) AS social_sso_rows,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (site_name) * FROM portal_apply_limits ORDER BY site_name ASC
  ) l) AS limit_rows,
  (SELECT row_to_json(ws) FROM (SELECT auth_email, auth_status, custom_preferences_note, updated_at FROM portal_credentials_vault WHERE site_name = 'CareerPulse_Web_Session' LIMIT 1) ws) AS web_session,
  (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM master_resume_state m WHERE id = 1) AS master_resume,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rc)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM reference_contacts_cache ORDER BY company_name ASC
  ) rc) AS ref_contacts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(ea)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM job_hunter_email_alerts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15
  ) ea) AS email_alerts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(al)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT id, event_time,
           TO_CHAR(event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'DD Mon YYYY, HH24:MI:SS') AS ist_time,
           table_name, operation, record_id, summary, changed_fields, LEFT(sql_query, 800) AS sql_query
    FROM database_audit_log
    WHERE '{{ $json.body && $json.body.action ? $json.body.action : "" }}' = 'db_monitor'
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 60
  ) al) AS db_audit_logs;
